source.dataset: CROWD: City Road Observations With Dashcams (crowd-dataset/crowd)
source.licence: CC BY 4.0 (CROWD DATA_LICENSE.md); YouTube videos are not redistributed
source.citation: Alam, M. S., Bazilinska, O., & Bazilinskyy, P. (2026). A global dataset of continuous urban dashcam driving. arXiv:2604.01044
source.notes: per_min: unique YOLO (yolo11x) tracks with confidence >= 0.7 per processed minute of footage (every viewpoint; COCO classes person, car, bicycle, motorcycle, bus, truck; 'truck' also takes vans and pickups, 'motorcycle' scooters and mopeds; parked vehicles count too); day / night from CROWD's time_of_day label, given where a level has an hour of each.
